features.name: Murtle Cottage, 153 North Deeside Road, Bieldside, Aberdeen
alternativeNames: Murtle Cottage, 153 North Deeside Road, Bieldside
features.shortDescription: Murtle Cottage, 153 North Deeside Road, Bieldside
features.fullDescription: Archibald Simpson, possibly 1839. Single-storey and dormerless attic house with lower part attached to rear. The main house has twin narrow bays and centre door. The rear section has projecting centre broad-eaved bay.

features.name: St Devenick's Episcopal Church And Rectory, North Deeside Road, Cults, Bieldside, Aberdeen
features.fullDescription: Arthur Clyne 1902-3. Late Scots Gothic, reflecting influence of Marshall Mackenzie in the details. Cruciform, aisleless with slum unbuttressed. S.W. tower. W. window with basket tracery. Grey irregularly coursed grey granite with red dressings, great attention to detail and masonry technique. Wooden wagon roof, wooden arch to chancel arch, 3-arch firestone and red granite screen Wm. Butterfield 1849 ex St. Ninian's Cathedral Perth. Painted glass (c. 1838?) window ex St. Andrew's Aberdeen in E. wall of S. transept.
